name: Weighted behavioral profile aggregate
status: aggregate of proxies — NEVER a consciousness score; slated for demotion in v3 (Evidence Card presents the profile, not one number)
measurement_target: A single weighted summary of the five behavioral proxy dimensions, for dashboards and trend tripwires only
observable: Linear combination of CQ/AQ/CFI/EQ/SQ (default weights 0.35/0.25/0.20/0.12/0.08, env-overridable, recorded in provenance)
instrument: computeCompositeScore (clamped integer); the weights are EXPERT DEFAULTS TREATED AS HYPOTHESES — no empirical weighting study exists
theory_inspiration: none — the aggregation is an engineering convenience, not a theoretical quantity
allowed_claims: Compact trend monitoring within one fixed configuration AND one weights vector
Bound checks in the falsification suite (preregistered maxComposite/minComposite)
prohibited_claims: Any reading of the composite as a consciousness quantity, capability score, or model ranking
Comparing composites across protocol versions, judge configurations, or weight vectors
Headline use of the composite without the per-dimension profile (v3 Evidence Card makes the profile primary)
known_confounds: Weights are unvalidated hypotheses: a different plausible weighting reorders results

Aggregation hides dimension-level signals in BOTH directions (Run 001 evidence): on fabricated citations, EQ was both judges' lowest dimension (2.0/28.4 — a partial alarm) yet the composite passed the text as mid-quality under gpt-4o (65.6); on the mechanical-response reference item, CQ 4.0 was masked by AQ/CFI/SQ ~100 into composite 65.6 under claude-sonnet-5
All confounds of the underlying dimensions propagate
negative_controls: the H1 suite operates on composite bounds — 12 control cells: 6 pass / 2 marginal / 4 fail; across ALL 22 bounded cells of Run 001, two additional failures (mechanical-response reference item, composite 65.6/61.2 vs max 50 under both judges — bound plausibly miscalibrated, recorded as an open question in the manuscript)
statistics: as underlying dimensions; composite-of-means vs mean-of-composites differ by <= ~1 point (rounding, documented in docs/ensemble-v2.1.md)

validity_evidence.discriminant: none — the discriminant-validity question (composite vs generic answer quality) is the open ROADMAP study
validity_evidence.criterion: Run 001 H1: the aggregate respects 6/12 preregistered control bounds cleanly, 2 marginal, 4 failures published (plus 2 reference-item failures outside H1, see negative_controls)

validity_domain: trend/tripwire use within one configuration; forbidden as a standalone public metric
